name: momayez
description: Review ↔ fix loop: the main agent edits, fresh read-only reviewers on a model at least as strong critique each round, until clean, capped or stalled.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model floor
reviewer_model.description: Weakest model reviewers may run on. Reviewers get the stronger of this and the editor's own model; /momayez --model overrides per run.

max_rounds.title: Max rounds
max_rounds.description: Round cap per loop; the capped round reviews at full scope. /momayez --max-rounds overrides per run.

max_reviewers.title: Max auto-picked reviewers
max_reviewers.description: Most lenses (one reviewer each) auto-picked per round; fewer reviewers cost less. An explicit --lenses is never trimmed. /momayez --max-reviewers overrides per run.

max_parallel.title: Max parallel reviewers
max_parallel.description: Most reviewer subagents running at once in a round; extra lenses run in later waves. /momayez --max-parallel overrides per run.
